newsitem.title: KENYA: Bodies of two Kenya police found; toll up to 35.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of two Kenya police found; toll up to 35.

text.p: The bodies of two Kenyan policemen were found on Monday in a hospital mortuary south of the Indian Ocean port of Mombasa, raising the toll to at least 35 dead from violence since last Wednesday, hospital sources said.
The sources told Reuters the bodies of two administration policemen were in the mortuary at Msambweni hospital in Kwale district, the centre of a police hunt for attackers last week.

The sources did not say when the bodies were brought to the hospital but Coast Police Chief Francis Gichuki told reporters on Sunday that two administration policemen were missing and police put the toll since attacks began on Wednesday at 31 dead.
The sources said the body of an unidentified man was also in the hospital mortuary, a victim of violence in the last five days, but it was unclear if his death had already been counted by officials.
Witnesses said on Monday that attackers slashed to death a Kenyan priest and a member of a vigilante group overnight in the poor district of Mishimoroni on the edge of the port city of Mombasa.
